title: Makes it so much easier to carry a pie
text:
Makes it so much easier to carry a pie. It makes life easier, especially during the holidays. I didn't try carrying it by the handle. Pies are too precious. I would never trust any handle when it comes to pie!

Updating to say that I did try the handle and felt that it was safe! I do tend to support it though and recommend that everyone does.

I think this set would make a wonderful gift. Bake the pie in the included Pyrex dish & then carry it safely to wherever you're going!

I feel it's well worth the money saved, and of course the mess that it saves too!

Buy it, you won't regret it!
